title: Buyer Beware
text:
I caught this app using my front camera in the background when my phone was locked. 

My watch makes suggestions to use various tools depending on various contexts. One such context is when the camera is open, my watch will suggest the use of the camera remote. 

My watch suggested to use my camera remote randomly and would not dismiss. I looked at my locked phone (it was kinda dark in the room, and inside the Dynamic Island I saw the little red infrared light barely and dimly on (mind you my phone was on the table and I was not touching or moving it). 

I recalled that I downloaded this app earlier today and remembered having to agree to their terms of service in order to use the app (red flag). 

On a whim I uninstalled the app to see if that did anything and wouldn’t you know it, my watch suggestion went away and I no longer saw the dim red light in my Dynamic Island.

title: Problem Trimming After Update
text:
Unfortunately, the latest software update has resulted in problems for me that make the app unusable.  

When importing a video file it only allows you to shorten it to 60 frames. This has always been the case.  In the past, if I wanted the imported file to have fewer frames, I would simply hit the trim button and do it in real-time.     

With the latest update the trim interface does not show you what the new frame count is, so you're shortening the file without knowing the result until after you complete the process.  

Before the update, when trimming an imported file, it showed you the frame count in real-time as you shortened it.   

Please return this functionality.
